meta.name: The Great Heist
meta.description: Based on the 1994 robbery of US$33 million from Colombia's central bank, which turned the country upside down.

videos.title: The Big One
videos.overview: Professional thief and con man Chayo is struggling financially and must convince an old friend to plan a heist on Colombia's Bank of the Republic.

videos.title: The Crew
videos.overview: Chayo and Molina recruit a team while finalizing details for the bank heist, facing multiple challenges that threaten their carefully constructed plan.

videos.title: Punch
videos.overview: As the thieves start executing the heist, an unexpected difficulty involving the bank's safe significantly delays their progress and tensions arise.

videos.title: Escape from Valledupar
videos.overview: Once the thieves leave the bank, Chayo, Molina and Mrs. K face obstacles in transporting such an enormous amount of money out of the city.

videos.title: Funny Money
videos.overview: When the Bank of the Republic and law enforcement team shows up to throw a wrench in the thieves' plans, everyone involved with the heist is endangered.

videos.title: All the Money in the World
videos.overview: With one betrayal, the dominoes start to fall for the thieves as investigators capture those responsible for the heist.
